thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER: Severity P2 - elevated 5xx rate on /v1/generate in us-west-2 (affecting hosted API). Threshold crossed at 2026-02-12T14:07:42Z. Paging @oncall rotation.
Sam W: Ack - I'm on it. Adding context: Canary model deploy at 14:05:10Z rolled out to 10% traffic for model-id redwood-gpt-7b-canary-v2.
Priya R: Noted. Any customer-facing error messages?
Jorge L: Logs show backend returning 502 from inference runtime. Sample: `rpc error: code = Unavailable desc = failed to read response`
Nina O: Seeing latency spikes too, 95th jumps from 180ms -> 1.2s around the same timestamp.
Sam W: Quick checklist: (1) confirm rollout weight, (2) check model binary/quant artifacts, (3) look for infra OOMs, (4) check KV cache misses.
Priya R: Running query for rollout weight... `curl -s https://admin/api/rollouts?model=redwood-gpt-7b-canary-v2` -> returns weight=0.10, status=deployed
ops-rotation: oncall-bot: please post svc-level graph links - useful for incident timeline
Sam W: svc graphs: https://metrics.redwood/svc/api-gateway/us-west-2?from=14:00&to=14:15 | infra-gpu: https://metrics.redwood/infra/gpu?from=14:00&to=14:15
Priya R: Pulling runtime logs from the instance pool: `kubectl logs -l app=redwood-runtime -n prod -c runtime --since=20m`
Jorge L: Found repeated stacktraces:
```
2026-02-12T14:06:22Z runtime ERROR: failed kernel select for layer 7: invalid kernel id -1
2026-02-12T14:06:22Z runtime ERROR: model init failed for shard 3
2026-02-12T14:06:23Z proxy WARN: upstream returned 502
```
Sam W: Hmm kernel select failure. Could be quantization mismatch or bad kernel table from the new model build. Priya, can you confirm model artifact checksum?
Priya R: Artifact manifest for canary-v2: `sha256: a3f5...9c2`. Comparing to build artifacts: previous stable (v1) checksum `sha256: b8e2...1d0`. Build pipeline logs show a relink step changed kernel cfg. Pinging infra-build: @Jorge any recent changes to kernel selection logic?
Jorge L: I pushed a change last week to allow dynamic kernel fallback heuristics. Shouldn't affect selection normally, but the new model quant profile has a missing fallback entry. Filing hypothesis H1: model quant profile doesn't include kernel fallback entries causing select failure -> runtime errors -> 502s.
Nina O: H2: rollout routing overloaded a subset of instances leading to OOMs. Checking node OOM events... `kubectl get events --field-selector reason=OOMKill --since=30m` -> none in that window.
Sam W: H3: cache hotkey - KV cache miss storms due to changed prefix distribution in canary inputs. Looking for KV cache miss metric spikes.
ops-rotation: QA-bot: can we diff canary vs stable model manifests?
QA-bot: Diff produced:
```
- quant_profile: int8_dynamic
+ quant_profile: int8_dynamic (missing fallback_kernels)
- kernel_table: stable_kernels_v3
+ kernel_table: stable_kernels_v3
```
Sam W: Ok this aligns with H1. Immediate mitigation options: (A) rollback canary to 0% weight, (B) pin canary to fallback model variant that includes fallback_kernels, (C) deploy quick hotfix to runtime to tolerate missing fallback.
Priya R: What's the customer impact? ops-rotation: some enterprise customers in us-west-2 report request failures for batch inference and interactive chat. Correlation with error pages shows high-value accounts A and C saw 40% request failure rate between 14:06-14:12 UTC.
Jorge L: I propose rollback to 0% now to stop impact and then re-run a corrected artifact. ETA for rollback ~2m via admin API.
Sam W: Agreed. Rolling back. `curl -X POST https://admin/api/rollouts/adjust -d '{"model":"redwood-gpt-7b-canary-v2","weight":0}'` -> 200 OK.
incident-bot: Deploy bot: canary-weight-change: model redwood-gpt-7b-canary-v2 weight set to 0 at 2026-02-12T14:09:03Z by Sam W
Priya R: Monitoring error rate after rollback...
Nina O: Error rate dropping. 5xx rate back to baseline by 14:11:20Z. Latency returning to normal by 14:12:05Z.
Sam W: Great. Decision: rollback performed. Root-cause hypotheses capture: H1 (primary) quant profile missing fallback_kernels in model artifact -> kernel select failure; H2 (secondary) routing concentration unlikely; H3 deprioritized.
Jorge L: Collecting full set of logs/artifacts for RCA: runtime logs, build manifest, artifact checksums, kernel selection trace. I'll attach tarball to the incident ticket.
Priya R: Initial customer impact note: Affected customers: Acme Corp (chat), FinSoft Inc (batch). Estimated affected requests ~12k, error budget burn ~0.6%. Need customer comms (CS + Account Execs) - assign to @Sam W and @Nina O to draft.
Sam W: Will draft comms and coordinate with CS. Nina, can you confirm SLA impact and open support cases?
Nina O: On it. Creating cases and flagging for priority.
ops-rotation: Post-incident actions: 1) block model artifacts missing fallback_kernels in build pipeline (CI check) - owner: Jorge, 2) add model manifest linting in onboarding docs - owner: Priya, 3) add canary weight automated rollback if 5xx > threshold for 3m - owner: infra-team, 4) follow-up RCA meeting tomorrow 10:00 PST - owner: Sam.
Priya R: Quick verification: run `sha256sum` on canary artifact stored in s3 vs CI artifact store to identify when the manifest lost the entry.
Jorge L: Found the offending CI change: job `model-package` skipped manifest merge step on 2026-02-11T22:00Z. Reverting that change pending patch.
Sam W: Thanks all. Moving this thread to postmortem channel after initial notes. Leaving open items pinned in the ticket.
incident-bot: Incident status: resolved -> mitigation: rollback to stable at 2026-02-12T14:09:03Z. RCA owner: Sam W.
Sam W: tl;dr: Canary (redwood-gpt-7b-canary-v2) introduced model manifest omission (fallback_kernels) leading to kernel selection errors and 502s; rolled back to stop customer impact; patch CI/model packaging and add linting + automated canary rollback.
Priya R: Adding follow-up tasks in JIRA: RED-INC-2026-143.
Jorge L: attaching logs + diff + PR link to the ticket: https://repo.redwood/ci/pull/3421
Nina O: Thanks team. :thumbsup:
Sam W: Closing handoff to RCA thread owner. We'll keep the ticket updated with timeline and full artifacts.
